verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is overwhelmingly developer/API-centric (Payments API, Invoices API, SDKs, MCP server, OAuth) and none of it documents a no-code dashboard feature for generating a shareable payment link; the closest items (square-docs-24/25/46) describe eCommerce provider integrations and general online payment acceptance, not a founder-facing 'create a link and share it' flow.
